headline: Across media, gaming, publishing and education, revenue growth is uneven and AI investment is a common focus.
summary: Media & Entertainment shows strong revenue at Disney (+7%) but mixed margins at WBD/Skydance. Gaming & Lottery revenue is stable with Bally’s up 20% YoY while Caesars posts a loss. Publishing firms are split, with Pearson gaining profit and Scholastic missing revenue. Education players are expanding AI and quantum initiatives, showing a positive outlook.

industries.summary: Disney reports 7% revenue growth and a 21% jump in operating income. WBD/Skydance sees a 13.4% revenue decline and tighter IT spend. Versant expands via acquisitions but IT outlook is unclear.

leaders.why: Revenue up 7% and operating income up 21%

laggards.why: Revenue down 13.4% and tightening IT spend

themes.title: AI talent acquisition
themes.detail: Disney is spending $180 m to hire staff from Character.AI and $60 m annually for the workforce.

themes.title: AI‑driven content
themes.detail: Skydance invests heavily in AI‑driven content creation and partners with Google’s AI news program.

themes.title: Distribution platform deals
themes.detail: Versant renews multi‑year distribution with Verizon and rebuilds Fandango platform for original programming.

industries.it_note: Disney is expanding AI staff, Skydance is tightening spend, Versant’s outlook is unclear.

industries.summary: Bally’s posts 20% revenue growth, while Caesars reports a $62 m loss. Light & Wonder and Brightstar show modest revenue changes.

laggards.why: Revenue $3.0 bn but net loss $62 m

themes.title: Vendor contracts
themes.detail: Brightstar extends New York Lottery tech contract for two years; Light & Wonder wins Delaware North Table Games replacement.

themes.title: Advisory hires
themes.detail: Former Caesars Digital COO joins Prediction Media as advisor.

industries.it_note: Brightstar is expanding IT spend; other players give no clear direction.

industries.summary: Pearson delivers 4% revenue growth and higher profit. Scholastic misses revenue and posts a large operating loss. Wolters Kluwer adds AI tools but provides no financial detail.

leaders.why: Adds AI to tax and medical suites

themes.title: AI integration
themes.detail: Pearson launches AI practice tools and AI‑native assessment; Wolters Kluwer embeds AI in Genya and Doximity Ask.

themes.title: M&A activity
themes.detail: Scholastic to acquire Cottage Door Press for $71 m.

industries.it_note: Scholastic signals tighter IT spend; Pearson continues AI investment.

industries.summary: Pearson repeats strong performance. NYU secures multi‑hundred‑million quantum partnership. SLU expands AI collaboration with World Wide Technology.

leaders.why: Quantum facility partnership with $284 m city investment

laggards.why: No new financial data, neutral impact

themes.title: AI and quantum research
themes.detail: NYU uses AI for archaeology and launches Animal Media Initiative; city invests $29‑30 m and $284 m in quantum labs.

themes.title: Industry partnerships
themes.detail: SLU adds AI‑focused partnership and branding with World Wide Technology.

industries.it_note: NYU’s quantum lab and AI projects indicate growing IT spend; Pearson continues AI‑centric product development.
